summary: Iteration 50 - Comprehensive testing of refactored ProposalView with Checklist-style DnD, contentEditable renames, and visual parity. All major flows (trade DnD, room rename, line DnD, persistence, override regression) working correctly. Backend layout endpoint persists and returns properly.

issues: All trades show only a single 'GENERAL' room instead of the documented KITCHEN + MASTER BATHROOM rooms from the seeded scope. The 18 line items ARE present (verified PLUMBING has 5 lines: cooktop gas line, prep sink, free-standing tub, double vanity, steam shower) but they're all grouped under one 'GENERAL' room per trade. This means the room-reorder-within-trade test (test 2) cannot be exercised meaningfully via the seeded data. Frontend DnD code for room reorder is in place and verified for line reorder which uses identical pattern - so the room-reorder code path is sound, just no multi-room data to exercise it. May be a scope parser issue in parseScopeDocument or the seed scope text doesn't have per-room headers that the parser recognizes.

action_items: (LOW PRIORITY / Optional) Investigate why parseScopeDocument is putting all 18 scope lines into a single 'GENERAL' room per trade instead of KITCHEN + MASTER BATHROOM. The seed scope text on this portal likely doesn't have parser-recognizable room headers. If the user expects per-room breakout, either re-seed the scope_document with proper room delimiters or adjust parser. This does NOT block any of the rename/DnD features built in this iteration.
(OPTIONAL) Consider adding visual confirmation toast/indicator after layout PUT succeeds (currently silent save).
critical_code_review_comments: ProposalView.js (1109 lines) is on the larger side - consider extracting LineRow, TradeBlock, RoomBlock into separate files for maintainability (>700 line file rule).
DnD onDragEnd correctly handles three droppable types (TRADE / ROOM-{trade} / LINE-{roomKey}) and immediately PUTs the updated proposal_layout - verified via network log.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes as documented in the review request - excellent test coverage.

Trade banner correctly uses getMutedRoomHeaderStyle (with halo glow + inset shadows + 135deg gradient) - confirmed in DOM: boxShadow contains 'rgba(239,68,68,0.5) 0px 0px 35px 0px' halo + inset shadows, backgroundImage is the 5-stop 135deg gradient.
Line rows use the Checklist alternating gradient (verified: 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.95)...' on first row).
Backend endpoint /api/builder/{access_code}/proposal/layout properly enforces proposal_edit_enabled check (returns 403 if not unlocked) - good auth gating.
